Autoimmune destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts. Thyroid disease is a separate comorbidity; pigmentation and xanthelasma do not establish destructive skin disease.

Reflex epilepsy triggered by hot water is a disorder of cerebral seizure activity.
Hereditary developmental language impairment is a neurodevelopmental disorder.
Ectodermal dysplasia and preaxial foot polydactyly define cutaneous appendage and skeletal abnormalities; additional organ involvement is not established.
Neoplasm arising in the inner ear; neural-origin tumors are subtypes, not grounds for a neurologic label across the umbrella.
Inherited red-cell membrane disorder causing hemolytic anemia; pseudohyperkalemia reflects sample-related potassium leakage, not systemic electrolyte disease.
Congenital absence of pancreatic tissue affects both the exocrine pancreas and insulin-producing endocrine tissue.
Structural enlargement of the thyroid is endocrine gland disease despite preserved thyroid hormone function.
